disclaimer: These apps are not malware. They are widely documented as building advertising and identity graphs. A user-installed profile cannot hide them on a normal iPhone. Delete them, use Screen Time → Never Allow, or — after accepting a full iPhone erase — install wipe-required/OpenHat-Level-3-Mullvad.mobileconfig (Apple Configurator Supervise, no MDM, no paid Developer Program).
screen_time: Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions → Allowed Apps / Never Allow
